messages:
Maya: Brainstorm: 'sidecar' DP path — small-sample async onboarding that surfaces a quick hosted demo + optional 10m async review instead of full kickoff. Aim: recover applicants who drop after signup. Thoughts?
Diego: Nice. What's the minimum treatment? UI modal + 3-step checklist?
Maya: Yes. Modal -> 3 quick config toggles -> run demo (prepopulated prompts) -> optional 10m async review with engineer. Stipend = $50.
Priya: What size and targeting? We should avoid noisy low-fit leads. Propose: target applicants with intake_score == 2 OR self-reported team size between 5-50. Cap total sample at 200 users.
Tom: Measurement: primary = % with successful inference within 48h (we'll call that `sidecar_first_infer`). Secondary = percent who book the async review.
Maya: Run as randomized 20% -> sidecar, 80% -> control (default DP path). Duration 6 weeks or until 200 sidecar enrollments.
Diego: Rollout: need feature flag `exp.sidecar_onboard_v1`. Also a CRM tag `sidecar_2026_q1`. Tom, can analytics emit cohorts?
Tom: Yep — will emit events `sidecar_enrolled`, `sidecar_booked_review`, `sidecar_first_infer`. Will build a small report: enrollment funnel + 48h activation + review conversion + support volume.
Priya: Acceptance criteria for the experiment to be considered a win: (A) +10pp activation lift vs control OR (B) if activation lift is +5-10pp but review-booking >25% and qualitative feedback has >40% actionable items. Either path triggers scale discussion.
Diego: Safety stops: pause if support volume >15% of sidecar cohort in any week OR if median time-to-first-infer >72h. Also stop if payout error rate >5%.
Maya: Payout plan: $50 via Stripe ACH. Payout-bot, create ticket to enable ACH for experimental cohort and record fallback GC.
Payout-bot: Ticket #6721 created: https://tracker/6721 1. Configure Stripe ACH for `sidecar_2026_q1` payouts.
Tom: Ops note: we need a clear tag in CRM so CS can follow up. Add `onboarding_path=sidecar` to user metadata.
Priya: Screener changes: compress to 4 questions + a checkbox "would you try a short async review?" Default unchecked. If unchecked, route to control.
Diego: Are we offering any special privacy/data notes? We should add a line: "We may use de-identified prompts for product research." Legal ok?
Maya: I'll run copy pasting through legal. Keep the form opt-in for prompt sharing.
Tom: I'll create the dashboard and the LaunchDarkly flag. Putting owners: Maya = program lead; Priya = screener + recruitment; Diego = infra + rollout; Tom = analytics + flag; Payout-bot tracks payout ticket.
Maya: Timeline: prep this week, QA flag + dashboard next Tue, soft-launch Thurs, experiment 6 weeks. Weekly sync Friday 11am.
Priya: I'll draft the modal copy: short, friendly, emphasize low time commitment and $50.
Diego: I'll draft the server-side routing and ensure rate-limits for demos.
Payout-bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-02-05 11:00 for first-week check-in.
Tom: Quick QA checklist: event firing, cohort tag, payout ticket status, support volume monitor.
Maya: Great. Next steps: Priya copy + form; Diego implement flag + routing; Tom dashboard + events; Payout-bot track #6721. Sync Friday 11am. :rocket:
